root_cause: Ollama cloud LLM account weekly quota exhausted. Provider returned fast failures (~0.4s per call, no real inference) for the gpt-oss:20b-cloud model. Operator switched to a second account (~69% usage remaining) at ~16:36Z, after which LLM inference resumed full production (5/5).
evidence: Trace comparison: AFFECTED runs show 5 'llm_service/llm_inference' traces with 0 'produced_semantic_inference'; RECOVERED runs show 5 llm_inference + 5 produced_semantic_inference.
Elapsed-time signature: AFFECTED runs complete in ~2.1s total (0.4s per LLM call = fast failure, no inference); RECOVERED runs take 14-32s (real inference).

Timing correlation: T6 FULL_RAPHAEL (16:32:36-16:33:37), T6 NO_HYPOTHESIS (16:33:39-16:34:41), T6 NO_FALSIFICATION (16:34:43-16:35:47) all llm=0/5. First recovery signal at T6 NO_FALSIFICATION s1101 (llm=1/5, 16:35:47). Full recovery at T6 NO_WORLD_MODEL s1072 (llm=5/5, 32s, 16:36:20).
Other templates unaffected: T1/T3/T4/T5 cells all show llm=150/150 (real calls) — the event is window-scoped to T6 cells collected during quota exhaustion.

affected_rows.detail: 89 runs with llm_produced=0/5, 1 run (T6 NO_FALSIFICATION s1101) with llm_produced=1/5

disposition_applied: CONTINUE COLLECTION UNCHANGED (per SENTINEL disposition precedent for the NO_WORLD_MODEL defect). No reruns during collection. Affected rows flagged post-hoc for sensitivity analysis. The frozen instrument code path is identical; the event is provider-side.
instrument_impact: None. No frozen code modified. Append-only JSONL preserved.
threats_to_validity_note: This provider event joins (a) early holdout inspection and (b) the execution interruption in the final threats-to-validity/reproducibility record. The T6_SEMANTIC_LLM template is the LLM-conditional template, so the quota window affects interpretation of 3 of its 9 cells; sensitivity analysis comparing affected vs unaffected T6 cells must be labeled exploratory.
